sources.entry: Intel VTune Profiler Documentation - Home of the user guide and cookbook, where each hardware analysis is defined by the events behind it.

summary.title: Intel® VTune™ Profiler Documentation
summary.one_liner: Intel VTune Profiler's documentation hub links to code samples, profiling tutorials for CPU, GPU, Java and MPI workloads, and training videos for finding performance bottlenecks.
takeaways: VTune documentation includes code samples such as SYCL matrix multiply, C matrix multiply, guided ISO3DFD OpenMP offload, and Tachyon for OpenMP or oneTBB.
Application tutorials cover Java flame graphs for hot code paths and identifying imbalances and communication issues in MPI applications.
GPU tutorials show profiling OpenMP offload and SYCL applications running on a GPU with GPU offload and compute hot spot analyses.
Training videos cover CPU performance, GPU application performance steps, and end-to-end profiling case studies.
The VTune Cookbook and oneAPI Samples Catalog are linked for further reference.
summary.summary: This is the landing page for Intel VTune Profiler documentation, organized into Documentation and Code Samples sections. It links to getting-started guides, sample projects that profile SYCL, C, OpenMP offload, and OpenMP/oneTBB code, and step-by-step tutorials for Java flame graphs, MPI analysis, and GPU profiling. A training section offers videos on CPU and GPU performance and end-to-end case studies. The page itself is mostly a set of links and short descriptions rather than detailed technical content.
